name: Convergence C / L / E
primary:
A projectile flies in an arc where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 1 ❤ lightning + 1 ❤ earth (lightning ×2 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Cold 40: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 4 targets in a row, jumps up to 4 blocks, 1 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Light push
• Breaks up to 3 blocks within 0.5 blocks (twice as many if brittle)
self_description:
On you:
• Damage 1 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Cold 40: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Stone skin (Resistance I) for 7.7 s
• Slowness I for 6.05 s
